input_binding.tile_order: K-major then N-major 32x128 tiles; row-major within each tile
input_binding.format: OCP E4M3FN with one FP32 per-tensor scale

codec.codebook_scope: one canonical codebook per fused runtime tensor
codec.code_length_rule: minimum weighted path length over a full binary prefix tree with maximum code length 12; zero-count symbols receive deterministic weight 1; ties are ascending FP8 byte value
codec.canonical_order: ascending code length then ascending FP8 byte value
codec.bit_order: canonical codes bit-reversed and written least-significant-bit first

decode_table.entry_layout: uint16 little-endian: low 8 bits symbol, high 8 bits code length

tile.stream_assignment: warp lane r decodes K row r, 128 consecutive N bytes
tile.row_length_storage: 32 uint8 byte lengths at the start of every tile
tile.row_payload: each row begins on a byte boundary
tile.directory: one uint32 little-endian tile offset per tile plus terminal offset, scoped to one runtime tensor

codec.fallback: none; all 256 byte values are represented

decode_contract.first_gpu_consumer: SM90 WGMMA B operand K32xN128 tile
decode_contract.physical_mapping: one decoder warp writes the existing shared-memory B stage and a warpgroup consumes it with the first WGMMA after a barrier
decode_contract.source_requirement: emit a real SM90 compressed-tile-to-first-WGMMA source only if the complete optimistic bound can reach 0.500119281574996 seconds/request; otherwise emit typed none

promote_only_if: all 29396828160 runtime FP8 bytes decode bitwise exactly
encoded size includes every named metadata and alignment charge
a physically optimistic zero-cost decoder complete bound is at most 0.500119281574996 seconds/request
the derived nonzero decoder throughput and SM90 resource thresholds are credible
